Uncrowned has Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello live results, round-by-round updates, highlights, ring walks and start time for the Smith vs. Puello fight card on Saturday at Utilita Arena in Sheffield, England. In the night's main event, Dalton Smith defends his WBC super lightweight title against former two-time champion Alberto Puello.
 Smith (19-0, 14 KOs) stopped Subriel Matias in New York in January to capture the championship. He now returns to his hometown for his first title defense. Smith previously won European, Commonwealth and British titles on the UK domestic scene.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Puello (25-1, 11 KOs) won the WBC title in 2024 with a split decision over the current WBA champion Gary Antuanne Russell. He lost it the following year to Matias. Before that, Puello held the WBA title from 2022 to 2023, until losing it after testing positive for the banned substance clomiphene. Puello was last in action in July, stopping Miguel Angel Bolano in four rounds.
 The Smith vs. Puello prelims begin at 12:30 p.m. ET and can be watched live here on Uncrowned.
 The main card starts at 2 p.m. ET on DAZN, with main event ring walks expected around 5 p.m. ET.
 Follow all of the action with Uncrowned's live results and play-by-play of the main card below.

 WBC super lightweight title: Dalton Smith def. Alberto Puello via split decision (115-113, 112-116, 115-113)
 Lightweight: Giorgio Visioli def. Maxi Hughes via majority decision (95-95, 96-94 x 2)
 Heavyweight: Leo Atang def. Jonathan Exequiel Vergara via first-round TKO | Watch video

 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 09:12 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 12
 Puello begins with a combination. Smith returns with a combination. Puello looks for a left. Smith connects with a hook. A lead hook for Smith. Clash of heads. They exchange lefts. Good shot for Puello. Pressure from Smith is the response. Final minute coming up. Body shot for Smith. They exchange lefts. Smith starts to celebrate. He believes he's done enough. I have it a draw.
 10-9 Puello, 114-114

 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 09:07 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 11
 Quick start for Puello to Round 11. A right for Smith connects, and another one down the middle. He is putting some pressure on Puello in this round. A right on the inside for Smith and he attempts another power shot. An overhand left for Puello. Now, to the body. Puello catches Smith with a left down the middle. Smith goes downstairs.
 10-9 Puello, 105-104 Smith
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 09:04 PM UTC Darshan Desai How they've got it at home:
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 09:03 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 10
 Combination from Smith to open Round 10. Puello comes back with a left. One-two from Smith as Puello was off balance. Puello's one-two down the middle hits guard. Lovely left from Puello on the stomach. A long left for Puello. Puello uses the shoulder to push back Smith and open up two lefts. Smith is missing with big rights and left hooks. Good defense from the challenger. Puello with a left. 
 10-9 Puello, 96-94 Smith
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:59 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 9
 A right hand finds the target for Smith to begin Round 9. The difference in power is evident. Smith looks to follow on the inside; Puello returns fire. Two right hooks for Smith. Puello counters with a left. Body shot for Smith. They exchange power punches. They are trading shots on the inside. Puello's left downstairs was probably the best. But then a double left from Smith. Smith makes Puello fall short. Puello walks him into a short shot. 
 10-9, 87-84 Smith
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:55 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 8
 Smith goes to the body early in Round 8. Puello tries a left to the chin. Smith looks to the body again. Puello comes back with a body punch. The commentary team believes Smith needs to be more active and they are not wrong. Body shot for Smith. Puello connects a jab. Smith comes back. A right from Smith excites the crowd. Lovely right to end the round.
 10-9 Smith, 77-75
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:51 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 7
 Into the second half of this one. Uncrowned has it dead level, but Smith could get some favoritism on the cards in some of these close rounds. Smith attempts the right. Puello throws the overhand left onto the guard. Nice body shot on the inside for Smith, and then they exchange. Smith is looking for the right-hand counter. He has neglected the jab and body work at times. Countering punch for Smith, but he perhaps needs to lead more with his offense. Two-piece attempted by Smith. They trade shots on the inside. Good luck scoring that one!
 10-9 Smith, 67-66 Smith
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:47 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 6
 A long left for Puello to begin the sixth. Another left he tries. Good right for Smith pushes Puello back, and Puello comes back. Smith drives Puello back with some pressure. A chopping right for the Brit. Smith connected with a one-two. A left-hand finds the target for Puello. Smith responds with a right. Puello on the floor, but no knockdown. Smith doesn't land with a combination but the straight right after it scored. Tight round.
 10-9 Puello, 57-57
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:43 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 5
 Puello doesn't connect with an overhand left he attempts early in Round 5. Puello cannot land with his left because every time he throws it, Smith takes one step back. Perfect footwork. They exchange shots just before the halfway point. Nice left for Puello. Smith lands at the body. Smith walks Puello into a short left hook. Puello is letting his left hand go more. Body shot and then Smith tries to follow it upstairs. Hook for the challenger.
 10-9 Puello, 48-47 Smith
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:39 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 4
 Puello is missing with his offense to begin Round 4. Lovely right from Puello. He was stunned there and changed his stance while Smith was looking to follow up. Nice body shot for Smith. Smith is on the front foot. Smith looks for the right-hand counter again. Puello needs to do something, or this fight is starting to get away from him. Just as I say that, Puello lands with a left-hand down the middle. Smith comes back with a right. The Brit is just rushing his work a little bit in the final 30 seconds. Good right from Smith to end the fourth.
 10-9, 39-37 Smith
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:35 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 3
 Smith drives Puello back early in Round 3. Puello just falls short with a long left. Back to the jab for Puello. It isn't landing, but it's controlling the distance. A left to the body for Puello. Lovely right-hand counter for Smith. I wonder how much the crowd noise will sway the judges. The Sheffield support will certainly help Smith. Another right finds the target for Smith, and now he counters to the body with that punch. A left for Puello skimmed him. Smith just falls short with a right. Counter right to end Round 3 for the champion.
 10-9, 29-28 Smith
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:31 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 2
 A Puello right hook is blocked. Smith tries to close the distance with a combination. Puello clips him with a left. Nice right for Smith, the best punch of the fight for him thus far. Smith hasn't worked the body at all so far. Smith just falls short with a right. Nice one-two for Smith. He's warming into this one. Smith is having success with the right. Nice jab for Puello. They exchange shots on the inside. A right to the body to end Round 2.
 10-9 Smith, 19-19
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:27 PM UTC Darshan Desai Dalton Smith vs. Alberto Puello - Round 1
 Here we go! The first defense for Sheffield's unbeaten Dalton Smith, and it's as tough a one as you will get.
 It's orthodox vs. southpaw. Puello is the left-hander. Smith loves southpaws, he says. Puello begins with his jab. A left-hand down the middle on the guard from Puello. Smith just falls short with a right. They exchange shots. Smith looks to jab over Puello's jab. Smith is pushing him back. Smith clips him with a right. Puello catches Smith with his left-hand. Smith made to fall short late in the opener.
 10-9 Puello

 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 08:01 PM UTC Darshan Desai Giorgio Visioli vs. Maxi Hughes - Round 10
 Visioli falls short with a couple of big swings in the first minute of Round 10. A left-hand clips Hughes just before the halfway point. Now Hughes eats a left hand. He fires one back. Good body work from Visioli. A left to the chin lands. A dominant final frame for Visioli.
 10-9 Visioli. Final score: 97-93 Visioli
 Sat, Oct 24, 2026 07:57 PM UTC Darshan Desai Giorgio Visioli vs. Maxi Hughes - Round 9
 Can Hughes make this fight a draw – at a minimum – with a strong late surge? Very little to split them through two minutes, with jabs from both landing. Nice left-hand counter for Visioli. Visioli is more active with the jab and on the front foot. He has probably edged that one.
 10-9 Visioli, 87-84 Visioli
